name: Bamboo-tube rice
summary: Rice cooked in a bamboo tube. The Thái Nguyên portal says it is grilled in the tube and eaten with sesame salt. VOV listed it at the 2019 Pac Ngoi market. This is the lake tube, not the Moc Chau or Mai Chau plate.
origin: Pac Ngoi. VOV, 25 September 2019. Thái Nguyên provincial portal, 1 April 2026. VnExpress handbook, updated 4 February 2025.
taste: The Thái Nguyên portal calls the sesame salt fragrant and nutty beside the tube.
howToEat: Split the tube. The portal eats it with muối vừng. Vietnam Tourism's rural desk, on 29 September 2025, also sets it beside crisp-fried stream fish.
The handbook lists “cơm lam, cá nướng thịt chua, xôi ngũ sắc” at Pac Ngoi. That line is not split into a separate sour-meat dish. A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Pac Ngoi, at the house, and at the 2019 weekend market. Whether that market still opens is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Cơm lam grilled in a bamboo tube at Pac Ngoi, eaten with sesame salt. A price is Check on arrival.
